newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Miwon Indonesia buys printing firm.
newsitem.headline: Miwon Indonesia buys printing firm.

text.p: Indonesian seasoning producer PT Miwon Indonesia said on Thursday it had taken over the printing division of PT Jico Agung in a deal worth 52 billion rupiah.
Miwon's director Bhakti Salim told Reuters the takeover was funded by proceeds from its initial public offering in 1995.
"We decided to take over the printing unit of PT Jico Agung to enhance our cost structure. By having our own printing unit, we will reduce a lot of costs," he said.
Salim said about 50 to 60 percent of the printing unit's production would be for the internal use of Miwon.
On Monday, the company said it had raised the production capacity of its seasoning products from 36,000 tonnes to 48,000 tonnes after a $20-million plant expansion in September.

Salim said the production increase and the purchase of the printing unit would help the firm achieve its 1996 net profit target of 10.5 billion rupiah and contribute about 50 percent to its net profit growth in 1997.
